role: Producer implementation and targeted checks, not independent safety review
implementation: Authoritative paint-tree dispatch; legacy paint_tree=None retained for isolated old diagnostic fixtures.
Only real group roots own input HWND+DIB; leaf static/dynamic/input caches are headless with invalid HWND guarded in hide/drop.
Child primitives cache raw own fill/text. Premultiplied subtree scratch combines all children first then multiplies each local alpha once; backgrounds do not inherit fill alpha.
Same-generation Page input binds exact scoped NodeKey+immutable card_index, with original material source/resource metadata. Group InputState aggregates exact clipped current targets.
Homework title/body share one data-leaf ID, courses/files each one; actual native pages enforce SceneCard visible_leaf_limit and material visible_rows/row_gap; full blocks/text remain owned.
Count actual outer glass<=8, graph depth<=16, glass depth<=2 including course/homework child layer, and total per-card page limits<=64.

Per compositor RGBA admission includes every persistent leaf/input/dynamic/container/root DIB plus simultaneous CPU scratch Vec capacities. An additional maximum single DC target BGRA-sized reserve is charged conservatively; static targets explicitly drop before input targets.

One-second tick renders only small dynamic cache and recomposes root clip patch; Vista+ UpdateLayeredWindowIndirect prcDirty uploads only that patch for visible root HWND. Offscreen tests do not exercise actual upload calls.

Recess native GDI regions partition fill/edge and exclude static/dynamic small DIBs. Small DIBs draw original full-card region shape and raw text, then whole small result alpha once. Remaining fill and edge regions apply combined native constant alpha without overlap.

Read-only explicit hidden export downsamples own root/small DIB pixels and own region geometry to <=960x540/2MiB transparent BGRA without allocating a whole work-area image. Reports source_work and two scales.
Process-local class registration now shared by RAII owner count, allowing resident+hidden preview renderers together; unregister only after last renderer destroys HWNDs.
release_surfaces drops caches/input/last scene/revision before local preview. Root serializes production resident raster and local preview owners; export renderer drops before Canvas adopts BGRA.
Materials fallback diagnostics use a shared pure warning label, included in both Scene measurement and native body, without rewriting real teacher/subject names.

primarySources.supports: Groups composite accumulated drawing operations; Windows 8 automatic null layer path is distinct. This implementation uses explicit CPU subtree groups, no D2D layers.
Uniform opacity applies to group result; Windows 7 baseline documented.
prcDirty limits source-DC update rectangle; minimum Vista, compatible API baseline for Win7/10/11.

limits: Nine new native tests are compiled, NOT executed by this agent. Root owns final real Win11 validation and failures must not be reclassified as PASS.
No real Windows 7, Windows 10 or Seewo evidence is supplied.

16MiB accounting proves this compositor owner's explicit DIB/Vec RGBA allocations and conservative nominal software target reserve. OS GDI/compositor, driver/kernel and undocumented D2D implementation allocations are separate measurements, not a proven hard process/kernel bound.

Multiple arbitrary public renderer instances do not share a global byte permit. Production root must release resident surfaces, clear old Canvas, render/export within scoped preview owner, drop it, then publish Canvas. Root has accepted that serialized ownership contract.
Returned preview Vec capacity is checked before use against 2MiB and compositor base+capacity<=16MiB; Canvas memory belongs to its own bounded UI owner after scoped renderer drop.
No user desktop, wallpaper, external window or file is read by export. Old explicit BMP diagnostic API remains separately bounded as before.
No remote test, global system/SSH/key/firewall/foreground change, cleanup or commit performed.
cleanupOwner: root; /tmp/fc-round16-presentation-target and /tmp/fc-round16-native-target plus current logs/reports remain for unified final checks/cleanup
